propositions: Close dispatches the completion verifier unconditionally via verify_with_auto_resume even when the ticket already holds a cryptographically certified completion-verifier PASS attestation bound to the exact resolved close SHA.

The close precheck seam does not consult the stored signed completion op-cert before invoking the provider, despite the signature infrastructure already authenticating the record's SHA pin and material fingerprint.

A valid same-ref attested PASS at the close target SHA must be reused to achieve zero provider calls, while invalid, stale, differently pinned, or post-reopen attestations must fall through to fresh verification.

The reuse eligibility check must verify the authenticated SHA equals the resolved close ref, the authenticated material fingerprint matches current material, and the attestation has not been invalidated by a later reopen.
